def typed_dict_to_dict(typ: type) ->TypeDict:
    d: TypeDict = {
        "module": typ.__module__,
        "qualname": typ.__qualname__,
        "is_typed_dict": True,
        "elem_types": {k: type_to_dict(v) for k, v in typ.__annotations__.items()}
    }
    return d
